title: Structure of the buffered circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $m$ inputs, let $s$ assign each of its inputs either one of $n$ input vertices or a Boolean constant, and suppose every gate of $C$ has pairwise distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Then the buffered circuit has pairwise distinct arguments at each gate, every negation gate has exactly one argument, every gate has at most two arguments, and its size is $n+\mathrm{size}(C)$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on m inputs
s maps each of the m inputs to one of n inputs or a Boolean constant
Every gate of C has pairwise distinct arguments
Every negation gate of C has exactly one argument
Every gate of C has at most two arguments
